characters.name: ヤコブ（Jacob）
characters.description: Younger twin brother. Smooth skin, wearing a simple earth-tone tunic. Innocent facial expression, large expressive eyes, slightly nervous or anxious look. Chibi-like proportions.

characters.name: エサウ（Esau）
characters.description: Older twin brother. Hairy body (especially arms), wearing hunter's animal skin clothing. Strong, energetic, carries a wooden bow. Large expressive eyes, chibi-like proportions.

characters.name: イサク（Isaac）
characters.description: Old father. Blind, closed or faded eyes. White beard, gentle and frail appearance. Wearing simple old tunic. Soft rounded features.

characters.name: リベカ（Rebekah）
characters.description: Mother. Loving but determined expression. Wearing a simple dress and a head covering. Soft rounded features.
